sources.title: ABF 2024 Admitted Patient Price List — Inpatient Only
sources.note: the activity-based-funding inlier inpatient price per diagnosis-related group, linked from the HSE's Northern Ireland Planned Healthcare Scheme claim page and the list behind the CBD and NIPHS repayments. Rows read on 17 September 2026: F06C CRNRY BYPSS-INV INVES MINC EUR 30,040, F06B EUR 34,430, F06A EUR 50,579; F05B CRNRY BYPSS+INV INVES MINC EUR 45,093; F04C CRD VLV INTERVTN+PMP-INV INVES MINC EUR 40,253, F04B EUR 50,628, F04A EUR 80,201; F19B TRNS-VSCLR PERC CRDC INTERVTN MINC EUR 9,887, F19A EUR 42,060; F10B INTERVENTIONAL CRNRY PR + AMI MINC EUR 8,857; M01B MAJOR MALE PELVIC INTERVTNS MINC EUR 19,899, M01A EUR 26,820; M02B TRANSURTH PROSTMY MINC EUR 8,363; N04B HYSTERECTOMY FOR N-MAL MINC EUR 13,282; G10B HERNIA INTERVENTIONS MINC EUR 9,046, G10A MAJC EUR 15,366; H08B LAP CHOLECYSTECTOMY MINC EUR 9,867, H07C OPEN CHOLECYSTECTOMY MINC EUR 16,206. An inlier price assumes a length of stay between the low and high boundaries printed beside it.
